Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000186" [constraint]: The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000183" [constraint]: The event bus deploys on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000178": Team Cinder observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and flagged it since it is not their service.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000174": On 2025-02-21, Yuki handed the Team Cinder pager to Diego during rotation day.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
- memory_id "1000168" [decision]: The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000163" [constraint]: Priya is not the Atlas pager contact for the cycle starting 2025-02-19.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya)
- memory_id "1000160" [decision]: Tomasz Nowak takes the Atlas pager for the cycle starting 2025-02-19.  (about: Team Atlas, Tomasz Nowak)
- memory_id "1000154": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000135": The scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000117": The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events.  (about: event bus, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000114": The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.  (about: event bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000094": Oskar is on call for the Ember team to start the year.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000082": Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena)
- memory_id "1000075": Oskar is the only engineer on the Ember team for now.  (about: Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000068": The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000064": The notifier lives with Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000058": The event bus is owned by Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000011": As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena, Marcus)
Existing entity names: reporting service, event bus, Team Cinder, auth gateway, Yuki, Diego, notifier, push provider, Team Atlas, Priya, Tomasz Nowak, INC-2025-004, Ember team, scheduler, webhooks service, Oskar, Team Boreal, Lena, Marcus
